line.style: fill: none; stroke: rgb(0, 55, 142); stroke-miterlimit: 10; stroke-width: 2px;

path.style: fill: none; stroke: rgb(59, 204, 255); stroke-miterlimit: 10; stroke-width: 2px;

polyline.style: fill: none; stroke: rgb(255, 255, 255); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-miterlimit: 10; stroke-width: 7px;
